column1: # Lamakan Desert: Mia's other self takes over after the Manticore falls.

column3: Is that all it had? It only\nwoke up hungry. Pathetic.{end_wait}
Mia, it was one of the\nawakened. You enjoyed that.{end_wait}
And? They all end the same.\nKnow your place, Garet.{end_wait}
...Did I say that? I don't\nremember drawing the blade.{end_wait}
That voice again. Mia, the\nblade keeps choosing for\nyou. We need to talk.{end_wait}
